scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run migrate && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run start
